$comment: Lost Art of Closing — interventions. Tangga 10 komitmen: time → explore → change → collaborate → build consensus → invest → review → resolve concerns → decide → execute.

interventions.name: Commitment Ladder Mapping
interventions.expected_evidence: Every active lead is given a note: the last commitment fulfilled (from ladder 10) + the next small commitment to be requested + its date — 100% of leads mapped
interventions.contraindicated_until: Daftar lead aktif kosong / belum ada interaksi nyata — ladder tanpa lead hanyalah teori

interventions.name: Always-One-Commitment Rule
interventions.expected_evidence: Within 2 weeks, 100% of outbound conversations end with 1 specific commitment requested & logged (date/action/person) — no conversation ends vaguely
interventions.contraindicated_until: Commitment ladder (LC-I01) belum dipetakan — meminta komitmen acak tanpa tahu rung berikutnya

interventions.name: Objection Resolution Session
interventions.expected_evidence: Setiap keberatan yang muncul dijadwalkan sesi penyelesaiannya (15 menit, telepon/meet) maksimal 48 jam setelah muncul; hasil tiap sesi dicatat
interventions.contraindicated_until: Belum ada objection tercatat (log 1–2 minggu) — sesi resolusi tanpa bahan hanya membahas dugaan
